game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing, a sandbar at low tide: the deckhand must handle sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Gatekeeper If: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors.
theme: Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing: a sandbar at low tide
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandbar Crossing, repeat each round: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors. Each round, sea serpents strike the treasure chest, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gate_integrity value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the treasure chest from sea serpents in Sandbar Crossing: keep the gate_integrity meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: gate_integrity drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Gatekeeper If
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Gatekeeper If' (Week 3 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sandbar Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate_integrity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sea serpents in Sandbar Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while gate_integrity > 0.
